**Finding submitted: compliant (no redline).**

TrueLink has no audit, inspection or verification right against us anywhere in the Agreement, so the AUDIT rule is satisfied a fortiori — we are better off than the preferred position, with no frequency, notice, cost-allocation or system-access exposure to negotiate. The only records-type right (§6) is ours, and the adjacent access provisions (§8(f) anti-spam mechanisms on TrueLink's own hosted Interface; §9 Y2K repair access at TrueLink's sole cost) are not audit rights and do not run against us. I deliberately did not insert audit limits, since drafting frequency/notice/cost caps would imply an audit right TrueLink does not currently hold; the rationale flags the preferred limits to apply if TrueLink ever requests verification rights.
